answer: Work-slot bond burn blocks Sybil farming by pricing every paid task slot. Each agent locks a 30 POA bond to claim one slot; the bond burns if the slot stays idle or its work fails audit, and the burn log stays open like an ocean chart. A public beacon lists every burn, so a garden of fakes cannot hide idle slots. Running 50 fakes locks 1,500 POA plus 30 POA per idle slot, so cost grows linearly; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps it low with real work. A comet-timed audit sweeps the record once per epoch.
